description: v4: one main-agent session per task drives the loop; roles through codeg MCP by default; the conductor is gone
changelog: The conductor layer (arbor.py conduct, --as-conductor, the arbor-conductor assistant, the conductor: config section) is removed: the main agent of each task's session writes the contract, starts the task and drives the arbor.py loop itself, as in v2. The default executor is codeg (codeg MCP delegate_to_agent); the MCP task text now carries the dispatch header plus a Prompt: pointer to the assembled prompt file instead of the whole prompt. A stale conductor: section in .arbor/config.yaml is ignored.
